title: What Scripture Actually Says About Your Body (It's Not Vanity)
caption:
Some guys skip the gym and call it humility. Some live in the gym and call it discipline. Scripture has a third answer: your body isn't yours. It was bought, and the Spirit lives there.

So take care of it like it belongs to Someone. Sleep. Eat real food. Move every day. Don't neglect it, don't worship it, and train it to say no so it never gets to run you.

"So glorify God in your body." 1 Corinthians 6:20

Save this for your next rest day.

#faith #godlyman #fitness #stewardship #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
